prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a pet template and tweak their core personality traits.", "Choose Personality"]
1: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to back up your custom pet and sync across devices."]
2: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Your pet is now active on your screen. Use your taskbar icon or press Alt+P to summon controls anytime."]
3: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "We are generating your desktop companion graphics and custom animations.", "Desktop Pet Tips"]
4: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Pet", "Your pet customization and progress will be securely tied to your account so you never lose them."]
5: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photos.", "Quick Adopt vs Custom Build"]
6: ["For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with your pet facing forward on a plain background.", "Recommended: PNG/JPG under 10MB"]
7: ["Preparing Desktop Engine", "Creating high-resolution sprite layers for your desktop."]
8: ["Quick Controls Cheat Sheet", "Right-click your pet anytime on desktop to open quick actions, change behaviors, or hide away.", "Essential Pet Controls"]
9: ["Sign In & Unlock Starter Crown Accessory", "Create or log into your account now to claim an exclusive cosmetic hat for your pet.", "Free Bonus Item Included"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus gifts to incentivize account sign-in.
